metadata.description: spendctl for Cursor: a spend-policy sidecar for agents that pay with x402 or MPP. Try the login-free sandbox, or connect the sidecar you run.

plugins.name: spendctl-sandbox
plugins.description: Login-free sandbox of the spendctl sidecar: budgets, allowlists, human approvals and receipts against mock paid APIs. Nothing to install, no real funds.

plugins.name: spendctl
plugins.description: Pay through the spendctl sidecar you run (npx spendctl start): every paid call is checked against your policy, held for approval above your thresholds, and written to the ledger.
